rows: Same order as windows.csv; one nominal 2-second window per row except frequencies

description.raw_amplitude: 12 log10 mean range-cell powers; no mechanical absolute unit
description.phase_single: 128 log10 binned powers of within-frame phase increments
description.iq_multi_abs: 128 log10 binned masked-LS median IQ powers after per-cell amplitude scaling
description.iq_multi_shape: iq_multi_abs minus its per-window mean across 128 bands
description.iq_frame_shape: 128 log10 complete-frame-average power bands, minus per-window mean
description.power_binned: 128 relative linear powers before iq_multi_abs log transform
description.frame_power_binned: 128 relative linear complete-frame powers; scaling differs from power_binned
description.spectra: 1591 masked-LS frequencies, median of 12 range/RX cell powers
description.frequencies: 5 to 800 Hz inclusive, 0.5 Hz grid; frequency axis only

units: Relative signal features, not calibrated displacement or acceleration; not teacher embeddings
off_calibration: Computed during evaluate_environment.py, not stored as a primary array
validity: Fixed original radar configuration; 96% scheduled chirp coverage
